purpose: Installs Squire from the download under a fresh macOS user on a real Mac and checks that no Terminal window opens at any point. Takes the target host as a parameter.
title: Fresh install with no Terminal

testCases.description: setting Squire up from the download on a fresh Mac user opens no Terminal window: every new window belongs to set-up, the browser, System Settings, Apple's tools dialog or the Claude app
